semantics.getter: getter(outer, out): member = [outer + 0x788]; obj = [member + 0x950]; slot = [[obj] + 0x28]; if slot == default (0x5d89610, the RELATIVE addend of the .got slot at 0x64ed2d0): *out = 0, return 1. Otherwise: *out = movzbl(override(obj, [member + 0x30] + 0x40)), return 1. No null check anywhere; both arms return 1 unconditionally.
semantics.default: default(obj, arg): returns 0 unconditionally (xor eax, eax; ret). Its arguments are ignored, which is why the getter's default arm can store 0 without calling it.
semantics.masking_quirk: the override arm masks with movzbl, so only the low byte of the override's al survives: an override returning 0x1ab yields 0xab, and one returning 0x100 yields 0. The raw override return is not stored.
